chatBackground.notes: The chat panel behind the text, sampled from T7SEN's first tier screenshot (PNG, HDR off). Contrast hints are measured against it.

characters.notes: T22, T23, T43. Characters outside the Basic Multilingual Plane (emoji) count as 2 and are refused. Hangul syllable 가 counts as 1 and displays.
